description: Issue the code to paste into the profile bio. Use this when the account cannot be connected through OAuth. Calling it again while a code is pending returns the SAME code — it does not issue a new one. Tell the user to paste the code into the bio, save the profile, and only then run vibevo_check_social_account_verification. Requires the write scope + PUBLIC_API_WRITE.
name: vibevo_start_social_account_verification
title: Issue a bio-verification code (creator)
